evidence.title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/035_HippoRAG Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models.pdf
evidence.quote:
In contrast, our brains are capable of solving challenging knowledge integration tasks like these with
relative ease. The hippocampal memory indexing theory [75], a well-established theory of human
long-term memory, offers one plausible explanation for this remarkable ability. Teyler and Discenna
[75] propose that our powerful context-based, continually updating memory relies on interactions
between the neocortex, which processes and stores actual memory representations, and the C-shaped
hippocampus, which holds the hippocampal index, a set of interconnected indices which point to
memory units on the neocortex and stores associations between them [19, 76].
In this work, we propose HippoRAG, a RAG framework that serves as a long-term memory for LLMs
by mimicking this model of human memory. Our novel design first models the neocortex’s ability to
process perceptual input by using an LLM to transform a corpus into a schemaless knowledge graph
(KG) as our artificial hippocampal index. Given a new query, HippoRAG identifies the key concepts
in the query and runs the Personalized PageRank (PPR) algorithm [30] on the KG, using the query
concepts as the seeds, to integrate information across passages for retrieval. PPR enables HippoRAG
to explore KG paths and identify relevant subgraphs, essentially performing multi-hop reasoning in a
single retrieval step.

evidence.title: Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/209_Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering.pdf
evidence.quote:
Given the above challenges, we propose a knowledge
graph prompting (KGP) method for enhancing LLMs in
MD-QA. Specifically, we construct a KG over the given doc-
uments with nodes symbolizing passages or document struc-
tures and edges denoting their lexical/semantic similarity be-
tween passages or intra-document structural relations. Then
for the first challenge of alternative reasoning and retrieving
knowledge across different documents, we design an LLM-
based KG traversal agent, which can alternatively generate
the next evidence to approach the question, i.e., reasoning,
and select the most promising neighbor to visit from the con-
structed KG based on the generated evidence, i.e., retrieval.
Moreover, we apply the instruction fine-tuning strategy to
augment the reasoning capability of the LLM-based KG
traversal agent and hence refrain from repeatedly prompting
non-open-sourced LLMs for evidence generation. For the
multi-modality challenge, we add different types of nodes
to the KG characterizing different document structures and
hence enabling content retrieval within those specific struc-

raw: {"answer":"HippoRAG 的图由 LLM 将语料转换为无模式知识图（schemaless knowledge graph）来构造：“using an LLM to transform a corpus into a schemaless knowledge graph (KG) as our artificial hippocampal index”[chunk_a58244558a2137d85a4b8e53d5c4ebaf]。KGP 则在给定文档上构造图，节点表示段落或文档结构，边表示段落间的词汇/语义相似性或文档内结构关系：“construct a KG over the given documents with nodes symbolizing passages or document structures and edges denoting their lexical/semantic similarity between passages or intra-document structural relations”[chunk_4c2f9284ed69432f1dd6ad5217a9a783]。检索时，HippoRAG 识别查询关键概念作种子，在 KG 上运行 Personalized PageRank 沿图路径探索子图：“runs the Personalized PageRank (PPR) algorithm [30] on the KG, using the query concepts as the seeds... PPR enables HippoRAG to explore KG paths and identify relevant subgraphs”[chunk_a58244558a2137d85a4b8e53d5c4ebaf]。KGP 则用 LLM 图遍历代理交替生成下一步证据并选择邻居访问：“an LLM-based KG traversal agent, which can alternatively generate the next evidence... and select the most promising neighbor to visit from the constructed KG”[chunk_4c2f9284ed69432f1dd6ad5217a9a783]。因此 KGP 的节点明确可对应段落，而 HippoRAG 的 KG 是作为“人工海马索引”的无模式图、检索沿概念种子经 PPR 展开，不把“节点就是段落”作为其图构造与检索定义；二者不能直接共享同一种节点解释，因为节点含义与遍历机制在原文中描述不同 [chunk_a58244558a2137d85a4b8e53d5c4ebaf][chunk_4c2f9284ed69432f1dd6ad5217a9a783]。","citations":[{"chunk_id":"chunk_a58244558a2137d85a4b8e53d5c4ebaf","quote_id":"q2"},{"chunk_id":"chunk_4c2f9284ed69432f1dd6ad5217a9a783","quote_id":"q1"}],"status":"ok"}
